l10n:Outside Display P3 (hex: mapped int.t: Outside Display P3 (hex: mapped into sRGB)

l10n:Outside sRGB, in Display P3 (hex: m.t: Outside sRGB, in Display P3 (hex: mapped into sRGB)

l10n:Put the cursor on a CSS color, or s.t: Put the cursor on a CSS color, or select text with CSS colors in it.

nls:description.t: Edit the colors in your code in OKLCH, Display P3 or any of 205 color spaces.

nls:gamut.description.t: The gamut the picker writes in, for notations that can name wider colors (`oklch()`, `lab()`, `color(display-p3 …)`…). `#hex`, `rgb()`, `hsl()` and `hwb()` are always written inside sRGB.

nls:gamut.p3.t: Display P3: the wide gamut of current Apple and many other displays

nls:shaders.description.t: Whether 0–1 vectors in shaders (`vec3`/`vec4` in GLSL, `vec3f` in WGSL, `float3` in HLSL and Metal) are colors, and how to read them. Off by default: a vector is as often a position.

nls:shaders.linear.t: vec3(1.0, 0.5, 0.0) and its kin are linear-light sRGB

nls:shaders.off.t: Shader vectors aren't read as colors

nls:shaders.srgb.t: vec3(1.0, 0.5, 0.0) and its kin are gamma-encoded sRGB

pl.empty.hint.t: No colors here. Put the cursor on a color in a stylesheet, code or theme, or open an image.

pl.note.dev.t: This document is read-only. Copy the values below.

pl.note.editing.t: Editing the {type} {name}: every use of it changes.

pl.note.mixed.t: Some colors here aren't read: their color space isn't one this library has (an .ase swatch in CMYK, Lab or Gray; an iTerm2 color without a Color Space).

pl.note.virtual.t: An image's pixels are shown here, not edited.
